vision.title: Proud to add value for our business partners
paragraphs: Barad supports cable and communication equipment selection and procurement through technical knowledge, market experience and cooperation with established manufacturers. Founded in 1394 in the Iranian calendar, its activities cover electrical, network, telecommunications and fiber optic cables and specialist advice.

Barad’s vision is to become a trusted cable supplier with an effective role in infrastructure, industrial and communications projects. Manufacturer relationships, professional expertise, process improvement and long-term customer cooperation shape that direction.

Barad’s mission is to support customers from requirements review to equipment selection: sourcing documented products, offering selection advice, responding professionally, optimizing project costs and building lasting cooperation. Transparency and responsibility guide this work.

team.name: Hamidreza Shabani
paragraphs: He has led Barad’s strategy since the company began operating. His experience spans management, operations, trading, production, market development and the wire and cable supply chain.

His earlier responsibilities at Shahid Ghandi included copper production machinery, exports, marketing, commercial management, sales engineering and overseas projects. The catalogue also describes his service on the board of Iran’s wire and cable manufacturers’ employers association.
The catalogue records national exemplary exporter recognition and presidential appreciation received by Shahid Ghandi during his period of export responsibility.

team.name: Keyvan Shabani
paragraphs: A Barad co-founder with a master’s degree in industrial engineering, he focuses on international trade and the development of cross-border business relationships.

The catalogue describes his work on the manufacturers’ association training committee and training courses in international trade and fiber optic fundamentals for contractors, project teams and industry professionals.

team.name: Mohsen Jalali Farahani
paragraphs: His professional experience covers telecommunications, fiber optics, transmission systems, network design and engineering, and technical consulting. Teaching and familiarity with communications equipment form part of his background.

The catalogue lists earlier leadership responsibilities in optical cable design and engineering and transmission system technical review and standards at the Telecommunications Infrastructure Company. At Barad, he contributes to technical decisions, solution evaluation, design review and project support.

team.name: Mahmoud Nikdel
paragraphs: With a master’s degree in accounting, he manages Barad’s financial, administrative and accounting affairs and financial transparency.
His background described in the catalogue includes Shahid Ghandi, Arj, Pars Oil, Bella, Zorbal Shomal and Iran Compress. The catalogue also mentions his sporting background.

team.name: Masoumeh Nazarian
paragraphs: Her experience includes sales, trading, market development and quality control in the cable industry, with Shahid Ghandi, Simcat and Doroud Kelid named in her professional background.
Her knowledge of cables and electrical equipment, including glass and silicone insulators, supports her management of Barad’s telecommunications product sales.

team.name: Maryam Hakhamaneshi
paragraphs: She coordinates Barad projects using industrial engineering knowledge and experience in project management, specialist sales and client relations.
Her responsibilities described in the catalogue include planning, budgets, schedules, risk, quality, resource allocation, stakeholder communication, procurement and coordination between departments.

team.name: Yaser Khavari
paragraphs: His work covers specialist cable, electrical and network equipment sales and market development. Expanding customer relationships and industrial and commercial cooperation are among his responsibilities.

team.name: Kamyar Esmaeili
paragraphs: His responsibilities include correspondence, sales documents, financial records, IT and network administration, personnel matters and the coordination of head office operations.

services.title: Electrical wires and cables
paragraphs: Barad supplies wires and electrical cables for buildings, industry and infrastructure. Selection considers installation conditions, circuit requirements, documented manufacturer specifications and project requirements.
Manufacturer cooperation and technical requirements review support selection by performance, cost and procurement timing.
items: Flexible, stranded and solid conductor cables
Low and medium voltage cables
Control and thermocouple cables
Fire resistant and heat resistant cable families

services.title: Network cables
paragraphs: Barad reviews and supplies network cables for businesses, data centers, industrial projects, educational facilities and technology companies.
Transmission category, shielding, installation conditions and network requirements are checked against manufacturer documentation.
items: Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6A and Cat7
UTP, FTP and S/FTP structures according to the model
Business networks and communications infrastructure

services.title: Copper telecommunications cables
paragraphs: Copper telecommunications cable procurement considers pair count, conductor diameter, installation route and required quantity.
items: Aerial and buried cables
Jelly-filled and duct cables
Paired telephone and intercom cables

services.title: Control and instrumentation cables
paragraphs: Instrumentation cables carry data and control signals in industry. Cable structure, shielding, insulation and sheath are selected according to the circuit and operating environment.
items: Oil, gas and petrochemical projects
Power stations, mining and manufacturing
Control circuit and environmental requirements review

services.title: Fiber optic cables
paragraphs: Barad’s fiber optic procurement portfolio supports communications networks and data transmission. Buried, duct, aerial, drop and micro cable families are presented in the catalogue.
Include the fiber count and type, route, environmental conditions and required length in an enquiry. The manufacturer and final model are reviewed accordingly.
items: OBUC and OBFC: buried cable families
OCUC and OCFC: duct cable families
OSSC and ADSS: aerial cable families
OFAC / ODSWC and OFC: central-tube structures
ODC and OMC: drop and micro cables

services.title: Solar project cables
paragraphs: Barad’s solar project services include cross-section advice, DC cable procurement for panel-to-inverter connections and AC cables for the next parts of the installation.

The catalogue identifies UV, moisture, abrasion, temperature and environmental resistance as selection criteria. EN 50618, low smoke and halogen-free properties should be checked in the selected model’s manufacturer documentation.
items: Cross-section and voltage drop review with the project engineer
Panel and inverter connections
Insulation, sheath and environmental specification review

services.title: Fire resistant cables
paragraphs: For critical circuits such as fire alarms, emergency lighting, safety equipment and data centers, operating duration and fire performance must match project requirements.

The catalogue discusses flame resistance, low smoke, halogen-free materials, temperature and environmental performance for particular structures. Flame propagation resistance and circuit integrity in a fire are different characteristics; each depends on the selected model’s documentation and tests.
items: Review Fire Resistant and Flame Retardant properties
Review Low Smoke and Halogen Free properties
Check operating duration, temperature, flexibility and environment

services.title: Custom cable design and procurement
paragraphs: For needs beyond standard products, Barad coordinates custom cable design and procurement with manufacturers according to project specifications.
Operating conditions, installation environment and client requirements inform cable structure and quality review.
items: Requirements review and specialist cable design
Structure optimization for the application
Review of samples and specialist cable or equipment structures
Production, quality and evaluation test coordination
Product documents and handover requirements

services.title: Technical advice and project documents
paragraphs: Barad’s technical advice covers industrial, telecommunications, fiber optic and infrastructure projects from requirements definition and document review to proposals and handover coordination.
items: Technical requirements analysis
Tender document and specification review
Performance and cost comparison
Technical and commercial proposals
Design-to-handover support
Specification and standard compliance review
Final Book documentation coordination

partners.name: Shahid Ghandi Corporation Complex
partners.relationship: Represented by Barad in communications cables
paragraphs: Barad represents Shahid Ghandi Yazd. Fiber optic and copper telecommunications cables are the product areas described for this relationship in the catalogue.
The catalogue photographs show Shahid Ghandi’s production lines and manufacturing complex. Discuss the structure, fiber or pair count and installation conditions with Barad.

partners.name: Khorasan Electric; Afsharnejad
paragraphs: Barad is an official representative of Khorasan Electric (Afsharnejad). The catalogue describes copper rod production, granulation facilities and a varied product portfolio.

The described product areas include building, flexible, control, power, automotive, instrumentation, telecommunications, network, solar and fire-related cables. Products listed on this website have their own specifications and technical sheets.

partners.name: Simia
partners.relationship: Telecommunications product sales and supply cooperation
paragraphs: The catalogue describes Simia’s electrical, telecommunications and instrumentation cable production, including jumper wires, aerial telecommunications cables, twin wires and MDF products.
Barad supports telecommunications product sales, procurement and selection advice. Documentation and approvals for the required model are reviewed during the enquiry.

partners.name: Rafsanjan Industrial Complex
partners.relationship: Cooperation in telecommunications and optical cable supply
paragraphs: Copper telecommunications and fiber optic cables are the production areas described in the catalogue, which refers to Nokia-Maillefer equipment and Nextrom technology in the development of production lines.
Barad describes sales and procurement cooperation for telecommunications, industry and infrastructure projects.

paragraphs: The catalogue describes Simcat’s cable production and raw material supply chain, including PVC granules, aluminum wire rod and copper products, with production development and quality control.

paragraphs: The catalogue describes specialist cable production for power, energy and infrastructure, including high and extra-high voltage cable families and testing facilities.
Voltage ratings, tests and model specifications should be obtained from the relevant product and manufacturer documents.

paragraphs: Its described activities include network consulting, design, implementation, supervision and maintenance. The catalogue refers to cooperation with Gigant and development of network and fiber optic cable production.
Cat5e, Cat6 and Cat6A and optical cable families are among the described products.

technical.title: Power cable designation
paragraphs: The catalogue chart describes power cable naming and cites DIN VDE 0271/0276. It shows conductor material, insulation, shielding, armor, sheath, core count, cross-section, conductor shape and rated voltage.
Read each letter together with the complete cable structure and that model’s technical sheet. Open the original chart to compare its details with the selected product.
items: N: standard designation shown in the chart
A: aluminum conductor; copper is shown without this letter in that part
Y and 2X: PVC and XLPE insulation
B and R: steel tape and round steel wire armor examples
RM, SM and other conductor forms appear at the bottom of the chart

technical.title: Approximate copper cable weights
paragraphs: The catalogue appendix gives approximate copper wire and cable weights in kilograms per kilometer, covering flexible wires, flexible, buried, cooler, aerial telecommunications, shielded and double-sheathed cables.

These are approximate catalogue reference values. Actual order weight depends on the model, manufacturer, construction and production specifications; confirm final figures from technical documentation and sales for ordering and transport.
items: Table unit: kilograms per kilometer
Compare the same cable type and core or pair count
Conductor, insulation, sheath and shielding affect weight

technical.title: Information for selection and enquiries
paragraphs: Prepare the cable name or code, application, core or pair count, conductor cross-section or diameter, installation conditions and order length. Fiber optic enquiries also need the fiber count and type.
Barad reviews specifications, manufacturer documents, supply options, price and delivery arrangements from this information. Visits to the Niavaran office require a prior appointment.
items: Electrical cables: conductor, cross-section, core count and rated voltage
Copper telecommunications: pair count, diameter and installation
Network cables: transmission category and shielding
Fiber optics: fiber count, type and installation
Specialist cables: environment, tests and required documents
